qa_pair.question: Several different owners hold the rental properties in this portfolio. One owner holds more properties than any of the others. Looking at the equipment tracked across that owner's properties, exactly one item is meant for outdoor grounds upkeep rather than use inside a home. Which manufacturer made that item?
One outside contractor is assigned to more maintenance jobs than any other. Under which trade classification is that contractor filed? Answer with the classification exactly as it is recorded.

One lease that is currently in effect has no monthly rent charge recorded against it, which would be an accounting anomaly worth investigating. Who is the resident on that lease? Answer with first and last name.

Across the genuine rental portfolio, how many leases name more than one resident? This account also contains test-fixture records left behind by tooling; exclude those and count only real leases. Answer with a number only.
Nearly all of the managed rental properties sit in the same city, but one is located somewhere else entirely. Name the city that holds only a single property.
One of the managed properties is not residential — it is not a house, a condo, or an apartment building. Identify the resident on the lease at that property. Answer with first and last name.

Take the rental property that contains the greatest number of units. Among the leases at that property which are currently in effect, what is the highest monthly rent? Answer with a whole number, no currency symbol or decimals.

A few leases were created with an end date so distant that it clearly stands in for "no fixed end date" rather than a real expiry. Among the genuine portfolio leases — excluding any test-fixture records left behind by tooling — how many have an end date more than thirty years from now? Answer with a number only.
Group the chart of accounts by accounting classification. Two of those classifications contain exactly four accounts each. One of the two is Equity. Name the other one.

Two community associations are managed alongside the rental properties. One of them is located outside Massachusetts. How many bank accounts are named after that association? Answer with a number only.
